card.name: Just before German names and odd word starts
card.fires_on: Commas in lists of German philosophers, and word-start pieces like Con, Ex, Go or A that begin a longer word. The next piece is often a German-style name or a word like traindicated.

modes.label: Commas between German thinkers
modes.description: The comma in a list of philosophers' names, where another German name comes next.
modes.example: The idea of gestalt has its roots in theories by David Hume<<,>> Johann Wolfgang von Goethe, Immanuel

modes.label: Start of a split word
modes.description: The first piece of a longer word that is split, such as contraindicated or exacerbate.
modes.example: Drugs That Are<< Con>>traindicated With VIRACEPT Drug

modes.label: Words before German names
modes.description: A small word or title right before a German person or institute name.
